title: Best $0 Fee Credit Cards with Rewards/Points Currently Available in Australia?
body:
CommBank wants a monthly fee — What's the best $0 fee rewards card?
So CommBank has decided they would like some more of my money and are introducing a monthly fee on my current credit card.
Rather than happily paying it, I'm looking to jump ship.
What are the best $0 fee credit cards with rewards/points currently available in Australia?
I'm after something like:
$0 annual fee / $0 monthly fee
Rewards points or cashback
Decent points earn rate for normal everyday spending
Bonus points/sign-up offer is a nice extra
Ideally points that can be transferred to frequent flyer programs
No requirement to spend a ridiculous amount just to avoid the fee
I pay the balance in full every month, so interest rate isn't particularly important
I'm not chasing a premium card with airport lounges, metal construction, concierge etc.
Basically, I want to earn some rewards without paying for the privilege of having the card.
What are the current OzBargain favourites?
If you've recently done the same exercise, which card did you go with and why?
Also keen to hear about any gotchas — poor points conversion, low earn caps, rewards expiring, sneaky fees, difficult redemption, etc.
Bonus points for anyone who has a better option than CommBank's current offering and can explain why.
Let's see what the hive mind comes up with.
Cheers!
